propositions: Pass-1 finder silently downgraded from opus (frontier) to haiku (trivial) after b690 enabled req.config to be honored, weakening the blocking-findings gate without alarm

b690 made the model_ladder declaration reachable for the first time; prior to b690, PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config entirely, so Pass-1 ran on the runner's downgraded config regardless of YAML

Archaeology shows 115 plan-review runs on opus up to 2026-06-27, then zero opus runs since 2026-06-28 when _verifier_cfg landed; the YAML has declared trivial/haiku for five weeks while sonnet actually ran, indicating the regression was never intentional or tested

Pass-1 context-limit escalation now fires earlier because prerequisite bin packing sizes to cfg.model (haiku 200k) instead of opus (1M), burning tokens on spurious escalations that would not occur on the stronger model

The effective model of Pass-1 is invisible in sidecar artifacts (only verifier model is recorded), and a weaker finder produces fewer grounded findings that still yield PASS and claim proceeds, making the downgrade silent rather than detectable as a gate failure
